ML-529: We now let a piece be in movements: a suite whose bar numbers carry on is one piece, each movement keeps its own repeats and jumps, and a photo or PDF of one can come in whole.
ML-107: We added the tuner button to more of the screens you play at: a practice session and its rest, preparing a piece, and the Timer.
ML-158: We added the Tuning fork: a note to tune to, shown as your part writes it.
ML-517: We added three quick set-up steps for new members - what you play, how the app looks and who you play with - which you can go through again from Settings.
ML-528: We now keep the clef you read on your account, so a euphonium, baritone, trombone or tuba player chooses treble or bass once and every tool follows.
ML-460: We made Quick entry take a repeat with a different ending for each time through, as a carol or hymn has for each verse.
ML-527: We fixed the admin check so it can be answered when it comes up while a pop-up is open.
ML-324: We removed Challenges, now that practice sessions have replaced them.
ML-526: We made Home, My music and the other list pages fill a wide screen, with a slightly wider list.
ML-525: We removed the heading above a YouTube video on the play screen, to leave more room for the bars.
ML-524: We made it clearer that a band piece is seen by anyone who has joined the band on this app.
ML-523: We made it possible to archive pieces and practice lists you have finished with, and to bring them back from an Archived filter.
ML-522: We now keep the bar that is playing at the top of the play screen, with the metronome and controls pinned above it, and show its bar number.
ML-521: We gave reading a piece from a photo more time for long pieces, and it now says clearly when a piece can't be read.
ML-520: We fixed a fault that could sign some members out every time they opened the app.
ML-246: We are trying out a way to add a piece from a photo of the music. It is not switched on for members yet.
ML-519: We made the extra check on the part of the app that holds members' details quicker to set up, with a code to scan.
ML-518: We added an extra check before anyone can open the part of the app that holds members' details.
ML-516: We made Major and Minor clearer in the Keys quiz when it has both: the one being asked is lit up on every question.
ML-502: We can now warn a member who breaks the rules, and close their account if it carries on.
ML-512: We now check, before every release, whether it changes what members can show each other.
ML-511: We can now take down a band's practice list, or change a band's name, if it breaks the rules.
ML-510: We added Report to the play screen, to a shared band and to a band's practice list.
ML-515: We made it easier for us to see how close the app is to the limits of the services it runs on.
ML-514: We can now delete an account for someone who asks us to and can't sign in to do it themselves.
ML-513: We renamed the app Notably Better, with a new address, notablybetter.com, and our emails now come from our own address.
ML-507: We added a Report button to shared music, so anything that shouldn't be there can be flagged and taken down.
ML-506: We now ask anyone who sets up sharing for a band to confirm they are an adult.
ML-505: We added a line to the privacy policy for young players about recordings.
ML-490: We can now remove a recording from every piece when someone in it asks, and tell the people it belonged to.
ML-489: We added the Recordings tool, so one recording of a whole rehearsal can be given to several pieces.
ML-488: We made it possible to match a piece's bars to a recording or video, so you can repeat any bars or play them slower.
ML-487: We fixed a YouTube video that carried on playing after you saved a piece.
ML-456: We now accept MuseScore files as a piece's score or part.
ML-312: We added a start and an end to a recording or video on a piece, so it plays only the part you want.
ML-278: We now ask you to confirm, once, that you have the right to upload music before your first upload.
